issues.description: Default 'python:3.12' is duplicated in 3-4 places with no single source of truth.
issues.detail: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE lives in pipeline.py, the Commands.ts catch fallback, CellMetadataEditor.tsx, and the Jinja template chain. The postcondition 'displayed default equals compiled default' is not provable; a future bump will silently desync. Consolidate to one authoritative source (backend constant exposed via RPC/bootstrap) and remove all TS-side literal fallbacks.

issues.description: _set_base_image semantic change collapses 'unspecified' into a forced 'python:3.12'.
issues.detail: Previously self.base_image = '' deferred to KFP's own default when pod introspection failed; now it forces python:3.12. Two distinct facts ('user did not specify' vs 'user wants python:3.12') are conflated into one value, silently changing runtime image selection. Keep 'unspecified' separate from the concrete value and resolve at the edge.

issues.description: Effective-image precedence rule is reimplemented independently in Jinja and TS.
issues.detail: The template uses 'step.config.base_image or base_image or default_base_image' while InlineMetadata.tsx uses 'baseImage or pipelineBaseImage or defaultBaseImage or DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE'. Two implementations of one pure function over the same inputs invite drift. Name the rule once (resolveBaseImage) and document the canonical precedence step > pipeline > default.

issues.description: createBaseImageText always renders, changing the prior empty-return invariant.
issues.detail:
The function previously returned '' when no baseImage was set; it now always returns a

showing the resolved default with '(default)'. Callers relying on the empty-string sentinel for layout/spacing are not audited and the return-type frame change is unstated. Document the new invariant or guard at call sites.

issues.description: Inline Input replaced by a modal Dialog hides current image state behind a button.
issues.detail: The old UI exposed the current base image inline; the new UI requires opening a modal labeled 'IMAGE' (plus added dialog state) to see or edit one string. This adds components and click cost while regressing observability — the opposite of the feature's stated transparency goal. Consider keeping the inline input with the default as placeholder/helper text.

issues.description: Button width '5%' is an unmeasured magic constant inside an unspecified container.
issues.detail: A 5% width on a button labeled 'IMAGE' will clip or wrap unpredictably depending on parent width; the previous Input was 25%. No invariant justifies the size. Either state the sizing rule, let MUI size to content, or pick a measured value.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on two blocking issues: the 'python:3.12' default is duplicated across pipeline.py, the Commands.ts fallback, the TSX constant, and the Jinja chain with no single source of truth, and _set_base_image silently changes the pod-failure path from 'defer to KFP' to 'force python:3.12', conflating 'unspecified' with a concrete value. Secondary concerns: the effective-image precedence rule is reimplemented in both Jinja and TS, createBaseImageText now always renders (breaking prior empty-return callers), the new modal hides current state behind a button, and the 5% button width is unreasoned. Consolidate the default to one authoritative source, preserve the 'unspecified' identity, and reconsider the modal regression before landing.
